hero_subtitle: A cooperative quantum deduction game. Your team receives partial wavelength clues — work together to identify the hidden Quantum Code before the system decoheres.

learning_objectives.title: Quantum Bits (Qubits)
learning_objectives.description: A classical bit is 0 or 1. A qubit holds both at once (superposition) until measured — which is why 256 possible codes can be searched in far fewer steps than checking them one at a time

learning_objectives.title: Constructive & Destructive Interference
learning_objectives.description: Every Verify either reinforces or cancels out the proposed cell's evidence — the same way overlapping wave amplitudes combine or cancel in a real quantum circuit

learning_objectives.title: Entanglement
learning_objectives.description: Some clues ask whether two qubits in the code match or differ — a simple, tangible stand-in for entangled qubits whose states are correlated no matter how far apart they are

learning_objectives.title: Measurement & Decoherence
learning_objectives.description: Why quantum measurements are irreversible and how environmental noise collapses the quantum state
